questions.passage:
Expedition Leader: "Down into the dark trench descended our titanium vessel, braving intense hydrostatic pressures."
Journalist Elena: "Had our university not funded this expedition, these profound oceanic secrets would have remained hidden."

Journalist Elena: "Dr. Miller was deeply thrilled with the results, and so were all the research fellows."
